tagline.en_US: Orca Slicer is an open source slicer for FDM printers. OrcaSlicer is fork of Bambu Studio, it was previously known as BambuStudio-SoftFever, Bambu Studio is forked from PrusaSlicer by Prusa Research, which is from Slic3r by Alessandro Ranellucci and the RepRap community

description.en_US: Orca Slicer is an open source slicer for FDM 3D printers. It is a fork of Bambu Studio, previously known as BambuStudio-SoftFever, which traces its lineage back to PrusaSlicer and Slic3r. The software prepares 3D models for additive manufacturing by converting digital designs into printer instructions.
